resolution.question: Will doctoral candidate Femi Adeyemi and his three committee members converge on a defense date inside the department's November window within the next ten days?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, by the hard cutoff, the persistent event history shows that all four actors have agreed on a specific defense date within the department's November window. Otherwise resolve NO.
